# v1.1.3 — Test suite verification and conformance guard honesty

## Highlights

- **Conformance:** Drop weak IRI-shape `consistent_but_all_unsat` positive entailment shortcut; defer the WG case until DL proves ⊥
- **Tests:** Strengthen facade/contract/profile/EL/Python asserts against independent oracles; shared `semantic-fixtures.json`
- **Maintainer docs:** Test oracle policy and verification report under `docs/internal/`

Drop-in patch over **v1.1.2** — bump all `ontologos-*` pins together. No breaking Rust/Python API changes.

## Install

**Rust:**

```toml
ontologos-core = "1.1.3"
ontologos-parser = "1.1.3"
ontologos-facade = "1.1.3"
```

**Python:**

```bash
pip install ontologos==1.1.3
```

**CLI:**

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/eddiethedean/ontologos --tag v1.1.3 ontologos-cli
```

**Bindings (source-build):**

```bash
cargo build -p ontologos-jni -p ontologos-dotnet -p ontologos-c --release
bash scripts/ci-bindings.sh
```

## Migration

- From **v1.1.0**–**v1.1.2:** bump pins to `"1.1.3"` (no API changes).
- From **v1.0.x:** see [v1.0.x → v1.1.0](../../docs/migration/v1.0.x-to-v1.1.0.md) first, then pin **1.1.3**.

Full details: [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md).
